description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including details about land owners, parcel numbers, extents, and encumbrances. The document is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette, confirming its focus on land-related administrative matters. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
